actions.name: Aid
actions.requirements: The ally is willing to accept your aid.
actions.description: You use an action to help an ally.
actions.effect:
You must explain to the GM exactly how you're trying to help, and they determine whether you can Aid your ally.

Attempt a Relevant Check. The typical Threshold is 15, but the GM might adjust this Threshold for particularly hard or easy tasks. The GM can add any relevant traits to your action depending on the situation, or even allow you to Aid checks other than skill checks and attack rolls.

Critical Success If your ally attempts the check you specified, you grant them a +2 Situation bonus to the check. If you're a master with the check you attempted, the bonus is +3, and if you're legendary, it's +4.
Success If your ally attempts the check you specified, you grant them a +1 Situation bonus to the check.
Critical Failure If your ally attempts the check you specified, you grant them a -1 Situation penalty to the check.

actions.name: Move
actions.effect: Move up to your Speed. Crossing into a foe's Total Reach may provoke an Intercept.

actions.name: Rush
actions.effect: Move up to five times your Speed in a straight line, less your Load Strain in feet. You cannot use Reactions until your next Opportunity, and you are Off-Guard against any Intercept made against you during the Rush.

actions.name: Leap
actions.effect: Jump 10 feet horizontally (less your Load Strain in feet) or 3 feet vertically, without a check. Longer or higher jumps are an Athletics check, and count as part of the Leap.

actions.name: Crawl
actions.effect: While prone, move 3 feet.

actions.name: Stand
actions.effect: Get up from prone.

actions.name: Climb
actions.effect: An Athletics check against a Threshold the GM sets. On a success you move half your Speed (your full Speed on a critical success). On a critical failure you fall.

actions.name: Swim
actions.effect: An Athletics check against a Threshold the GM sets. On a success you move half your Speed (your full Speed on a critical success). On a critical failure you sink.

actions.name: Tumble Through
actions.effect: Acrobatics against the target's Awareness Threshold, to move through a foe's space. On a success you pass through, though their space is difficult terrain for this move. On a failure your movement stops in front of them.

actions.name: Squeeze
actions.requirements: You are entering a space narrower than your token size, but at least half as wide.
actions.effect: Move up to 3 feet, regardless of your Speed. While any part of you is in that space you are Off-Guard, Evade is unavailable to you, and you can attack only with weapons that have the Close trait. A space narrower than half your own stops you entirely: for a Medium creature, a gap of 1½ feet or less.

actions.name: Strike
actions.effect:
Attack with a weapon or an unarmed blow. Roll Melee (or Ranged, for a weapon that leaves your hand) against Evade or Guard, and deal damage and effects as normal. The actions you spend say how much of yourself is behind the blow (see Chapter 2: The Exchange).
❶ Quick. A probe: one weapon die plus precision damage, nothing else, on the Torso. It cannot Critically Hit (Agile weapons excepted) and Protection applies in full even to an Exposed Zone. Stopped, it costs you nothing and can only be bound, never Controlled.
❷ Deliberate. All dice, specialization, and your Might. It may be placed on an Exposed Zone, and on a Critical Hit you may Expose a plausible Zone. A Graze costs only the tempo; on a Miss you are Exposed. A Parry that Stops it takes Control.
❸ Committed. Prepared. All dice, specialization, and your Might. On a Hit or Critical Hit, you may Expose a plausible Zone. Weighted: Stopped, Graze or Miss, you are Exposed. A Parry that Stops it takes Control.

actions.name: Gain Control
actions.requirements: A rigid weapon, shield, or permitted natural weapon in hand; the target's weapon or natural attack is within the longer of your two Total Reaches; the target is no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Melee against the target's Guard.
Critical Success You Control the weapon, and the target is Off-Guard until its next Opportunity. Success You Control the weapon. Graze A neutral Bind forms. Miss You pressed badly. The target Controls your weapon instead.
Special Evade cannot answer this attack. While you Control a weapon, the target has an Exposed Zone of your choice and takes −2 Situation to attacks with it (see Chapter 2: The Exchange).

actions.name: Close
actions.effect: Step toward that foe. The Bind holds, and the Controlled weapon cannot Intercept you. This is the only movement that does not end a Bind.

actions.name: Grapple
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Grapple Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success The target is Restrained until the end of the next round. Success The target is Grabbed until the end of the next round. Graze No effect. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❷ Tackle. Move, then Grapple. Critical Success The target is Restrained until the end of the next round and knocked Prone. Success The target is Grabbed until the end of the next round and knocked Prone. You fall Prone adjacent to them. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity, and fall Prone adjacent to them.

actions.name: Shove
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Shove Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success The target is pushed 6 feet. You may Move as part of this action, if it is in the same direction. Success The target is pushed 3 feet. Graze No effect. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❷ Heave. You set your feet and put your weight behind it. Critical Success The target is pushed 12 feet. Success The target is pushed 6 feet. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Trip
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Trip Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success The target is knocked Prone, and takes damage equal to your Might. Success The target is knocked Prone. Graze No effect. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
Special If the target's Legs are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.
❷ Leg Sweep. Critical Success The target is knocked Prone, takes damage equal to your Might, and becomes Exposed [Legs]. Success The target is knocked Prone and becomes Exposed [Legs]. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity. The Special above still applies.

actions.name: Disarm
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Disarm Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success The item drops from their grip and lands in one of their squares. Success Their grip is loosened: −2 Situation penalty to attacks with it, and the next Disarm against them gains a +2 Situation bonus, until they spend an Interact to resettle it. Graze No effect. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
Special If the target's Arms are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.
❸ Wrench. Critical Success The item flies from their grip and lands 1d10 squares away, in a direction of your choosing. Success The item drops from their grip and lands in one of their squares. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity. The Special above still applies.

actions.name: Reposition
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or are already Grabbing or Restraining the target, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success Move the target up to 6 feet, staying within your reach, not into or through obstacles. Success Move the target up to 3 feet, staying within your reach, not into or through obstacles. Graze No effect. Miss The target can move you up to 3 feet as though it Repositioned you.
❷ Haul. Critical Success Move up to your full Speed, bringing the target with you. Success Move up to half your Speed, bringing the target with you. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss The target can move you up to 6 feet the same way.

actions.name: Raise a Shield
actions.effect: Gain your shield's Gear bonus to Guard until your next Opportunity. You must be wielding it.

actions.name: Recenter
actions.effect: Gather yourself: clear every Exposed Zone on you (except one Exposed by a Posture) and end any Bind you are in.

actions.name: Take Cover
actions.requirements: You have Cover, or Greater Cover, or are wielding a tower shield.
actions.effect:
Press yourself into your cover. Your Cover improves by one grade. Adjust the Zones Covered to match. This lasts until you Move, Step or Attack.
Special A raised tower shield gives you Cover with nothing to get behind, so Taking Cover behind one gives you Greater Cover.

actions.name: Escape
actions.effect:
Break free of a grab, a restraint, or anything holding you.
Roll your best of Athletics or Acrobatics against the grabber's Endure.
Critical Success You are no longer Grabbed or Restrained, and may Step ⓿. Success You are no longer Grabbed or Restrained. Failure The Grabbed or Restrained condition persists. Critical Failure The condition persists and their hold improves: if you were Grabbed, you are now Restrained.

actions.name: Step
actions.effect: Move up to half your Speed. Step has no Traits at all, which is the point: it never provokes Intercepts or other Reactions. Stepping ends any Bind you are in (Close excepted). You cannot Step into difficult terrain.

actions.name: Parry
actions.requirements: You have Guard Training, and a rigid weapon, shield, or permitted natural weapon in hand.
actions.effect: Answer an attack with Guard at a +2 Situation bonus. If you Stop a Deliberate or Committed Strike, you take Control of the attacking weapon instead of forming a neutral Bind, and you may at once make a Quick Strike ⓿ against its owner (the riposte). A Stopped Quick Strike gives only a neutral Bind.

actions.name: Void
actions.effect: Answer an attack with Evade at a +2 Situation bonus. If the attack is Stopped, you may Step in any direction.

actions.name: Counter
actions.requirements: You are Expert in Melee; the attacker is within your Reach and the attack is a melee attack.
actions.effect: Answer the attack with a Quick Strike of your own. You gain no bonus to your Defense. Roll both; resolve both. You cannot Counter a Counter or an Intercept, and the fighter you Counter rolls only their basic Defense against it.

actions.name: Intercept
actions.trigger: A foe Moves from outside your Total Reach to inside it, or Strikes you with an Unwieldy weapon from inside its Unwieldy distance.
actions.effect: Make a Quick Strike against them at the moment they enter. Once per foe per Move. A Wound stops their movement; anything less and it continues.

actions.name: Pass
actions.effect: Do nothing at this Opportunity. You may still use Reactions. When a full circuit passes in which everyone Passes, the round ends. You cannot Pass while Preparing.

actions.name: Seek
actions.effect:
Roll one Awareness against the Stealth of anything Hiding, or against a Threshold the GM sets for a hidden object. Covers everything within 30 feet.
Critical Success As Success, but the creature moves two states. Success The creature moves one state toward Observed: Undetected becomes Hidden, Hidden becomes Concealed, Concealed becomes Observed. Failure You learn nothing. Critical Failure You commit to the wrong place. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Hide
actions.requirements: You are currently benefiting from at least Lesser Cover, or from Concealment.
actions.effect:
Roll one Stealth against the Awareness of every creature around you (including your allies).
Critical Success You are Hidden to the creature, and they are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round. Success You are Hidden to the creature. Failure They still see you. Critical Failure You have drawn the eye. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Sneak
actions.requirements: You are (or believe you are) currently at least Hidden from at least one creature.
actions.effect:
Move up to half your Speed while staying Hidden or Undetected. You must end this movement with Concealment or at least Lesser Cover from each creature you wish to remain at least Hidden from. Roll one Stealth against the Awareness of every creature to which you are currently at least Hidden (including your allies).
Critical Success You move and remain Hidden and/or Undetected, and they are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round. Success You move and remain Hidden and/or Undetected. Failure You are Observed during your movement. Critical Failure You are Observed, and you are Wrong-Footed to them until your next Opportunity.
❷ Creep. As above, except: Failure You realize you would be Observed if you moved, and may choose not to move after all. Critical Failure You are Observed during your movement.

actions.name: Point Out
actions.effect: Indicate a creature you have located, whether you can see it or it is merely Hidden to you. It becomes Hidden rather than Undetected, or Concealed rather than Hidden, to any ally who can hear or see you.

actions.name: Demoralize
actions.effect:
Roll Intimidation against the target's Guard.
Critical Success The target is Frightened 2. Success The target is Frightened 1. Failure No effect. Critical Failure No effect, and it is emboldened: +1 Situation bonus to its Attacks against you until the end of the next round.
❷ Break Them. Critical Success The target is Frightened 3 and Heedless. Success The target is Frightened 2. Failure The target is Frightened 1. Critical Failure No effect.

actions.name: Feint
actions.effect:
Roll Guile against the target's Awareness.
Critical Success The target is Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round. Success The target is Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your next Opportunity. Failure No effect. Critical Failure You overcommit. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Recall Knowledge
actions.effect:
Learn something true about a creature, place, or object. Possible topics include Defense Thresholds, Protection and armor materials, Weaknesses, Resistances and Immunities, Attack Thresholds, Special Abilities, and maximum Vigor.
Roll a Lore or relevant Skill check against the level-based Threshold of your target.
Critical Success You recall all facts about two topics. Success You recall all facts about one topic. Failure You recall nothing. Critical Failure You recall all (incorrect) facts about one topic.
Special You may attempt this once per target per Skill, so a character with several Lores or relevant Skills may get several angles on the same problem.
❷ Study. As above, except: Critical Failure You recall nothing.

actions.name: Interact
actions.effect: Draw or stow a weapon, open a door, pull a potion from your pack, pick something up, work a lever.

actions.name: Release
actions.effect: Drop or let go of something you are holding.

actions.name: Drop Prone
actions.effect: Fall prone.

actions.name: Avert Gaze
actions.effect: Name one creature or object Observed by you. Watch its feet, its shadow, the floor in front of it. Until your next Opportunity you gain a +2 Situation bonus to your Defenses against its effects with the Visual trait, and it is Concealed to you.

actions.name: Grab an Edge
actions.requirements: You have a hand free; you may Release ⓿ an item as part of this Reaction to free a hand.
actions.trigger: You fall past an edge, ledge, or handhold within your reach.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics or Acrobatics against a Threshold of 15.
Critical Success You catch it and pull yourself up in the same motion. You do not fall. Success You catch it and hang there. You are Off-Guard. Failure You fall, but the damage from the falling distance is reduced by 10 feet. Critical Failure You fall the full distance.
